Estimate Momentum measures change in analyst sentiment over time and may be an indicator of future price movements. The Change in Consensus chart shows the current, 1 week ago, and 1 month ago consensus earnings per share (EPS*) forecasts.
 For the fiscal quarter endingOct 2026 , the consensus EPS* forecast has remained the same over the past week at 2.48 and increased over the past month from 2.47 to 2.48(0.40%). Of the 1 analysts making quarterly forecasts, 1raised and none lowered their forecast.
 For the fiscal year ending Jan 2027 , the consensus EPS* forecast has increased over the past week from 9.26 to 9.27(0.11%) and increased over the past month from 9.25 to 9.26(0.11%). Of the 2 analysts making yearly forecasts, 2raised and none lowered their forecast.
